name: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup with Carrot, Celery, Onion & Parsley (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 3 medium and 3 small food storage containers.

Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta, run under cold water to cool, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
85 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat another medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer chicken to a clean plate and set aside. (Reserve pan with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 stick celery
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds. Place in a small bowl.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl with the carrot and set aside.
Peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
2 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken is done, return the pan (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring often, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add carrot and celery to the pan and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1 minute.

Return chicken to the pan, add broth and spices, then stir to combine. Cover and bring the soup to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until chicken is cooked through, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cups chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
When the chicken is done, remove thighs to a plate using tongs. Shred the chicken using two forks; use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat.

Divide noodles between the small storage containers and drizzle with oil. Divide shredded chicken, soup, and parsley between the medium storage containers, then set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate.
When ready to eat, add noodles to the soup, then heat in a microwave or saucepan. Enjoy!
